metadata.name: Product Portal Frontend Architecture
metadata.purpose: Versioned architectural reference for keeping the frontend structure aligned with the retail platform backend bounded contexts.
metadata.scope: React application layers, feature ownership, Axios transport boundaries, TanStack Query server-state boundaries, tenant-aware behavior, and backend-to-frontend context mappings.
metadata.sourceOfTruthPolicy: The implemented source tree is authoritative for current frontend behavior. This manifest records reviewed architectural intent and must be updated in the same pull request as structural changes.
metadata.maintenanceRule: Review this manifest whenever the backend schema, OpenAPI contract, frontend feature ownership, application layers, or cross-cutting data-access policies change.

backendSchema.relationship: Provides backend domain boundaries, tenant rules, security invariants, and persistence terminology. It is not a frontend API contract.
backendSchema.updateRule: Changes to backend modules or cross-table business rules must trigger a review of backendContextMappings.

apiContract.relationship: OpenAPI is the authoritative contract for frontend request and response DTO generation.

packageManifest.relationship: Authoritative source for framework, library, and tool versions.

architecture.decision: Organize by user-facing business capabilities and bounded contexts instead of mirroring database tables.

layers.name: app
layers.responsibility: Application composition, providers, layouts, routing, and top-level error boundaries.

layers.name: features
layers.responsibility: Vertical business capabilities containing their own transport adapters, queries, models, UI, pages, and routes.
allowedDependencies: explicit public APIs exposed by another feature

layers.name: shared
layers.responsibility: Business-agnostic HTTP infrastructure, generated API client, reusable UI, hooks, and utilities.

dependencyRules: shared must not import app or features.
Features must not deep-import another feature's internal files.
Cross-feature composition belongs in app or in an explicit workflow feature.
Pages compose feature components and hooks but do not contain endpoint URLs or cache management.

prohibited: Axios calls from components or pages
business endpoints in the shared HTTP client
automatic X-Shop-ID attachment to non-shop-scoped requests

responsibilities: loading, error, empty, and success state exposure
queryKeyPolicy: Include organization identity in every organization-scoped query key.
Include shop identity in every shop-scoped query key.
Include selected profile identity when results vary by authenticated profile.
Use stable serializable filters and pagination values.
cacheIsolationPolicy: Clear authenticated server state on logout.
Remove or invalidate affected queries when profile, organization, or shop context changes.
Never duplicate TanStack Query server state in Context or component state.

dtoPolicy.featureModels: Owned by each feature under model.
dtoPolicy.mappingRule: Feature API adapters map transport DTOs into feature models before UI consumption.
dtoPolicy.databaseSchemaRule: Do not generate frontend DTOs directly from the relational database schema.

directories.name: api
directories.responsibility: Axios-backed endpoint functions, transport contracts, and DTO mappers.

directories.name: queries
directories.responsibility: TanStack Query keys, queries, mutations, and cache policies.

directories.name: model
directories.responsibility: Feature types, validation schemas, state machines, and domain-facing mapping rules.

directories.name: components
directories.responsibility: Feature-owned reusable presentation and interaction components.

directories.name: routes
directories.responsibility: Feature route definitions and route metadata.

featureTemplate.publicApiPolicy: Add an index.ts public API when a feature exports implementation. Do not expose internal files through deep imports.
featureTemplate.creationPolicy: Create implementation files only when the corresponding capability is being developed.

responsibilities: session-bound identity and selected profile context
roles, permissions, assignments, and scope-aware UI
customer roles, permissions, and scoped access
order, payment, and fulfillment status presentation

features.name: shops
features.note: Current implementation uses static favorite-shop presentation data and should be split by capability as APIs are introduced.

tenantContext: Organization context comes from trusted host, path, or authenticated session resolution.
Client input never overrides a trusted organization context.
Organization-level operations may run without shop context.
Shop-scoped operations require an explicit or server-derived shop.
The frontend never infers an organization-wide default shop.
authorization: The selected session profile type and profile identifier remain explicit.
The UI renders actions from permission codes and assignment scope, not role names.
Frontend guards improve user experience but never replace backend authorization.
security: Do not store secrets in frontend code.
Prefer secure HttpOnly cookies or in-memory access tokens over localStorage bearer tokens.
Do not expose raw Axios error payloads directly to users.
Clear protected query data when the authenticated context ends.
dataTypes: Represent decimal money values as decimal strings or explicit money value objects, never binary floating point.
Treat API status codes as stable identifiers and map display labels in presentation code.
Parse and display timestamps at system boundaries using the relevant organization or shop timezone.
responsiveAndAccessibility: Use semantic HTML, labeled controls, keyboard interaction, and managed focus.
Cover breakpoint-sensitive navigation and workflows with Playwright.

updateTriggers: A backend schema module is added, renamed, split, or removed.
An OpenAPI operation changes feature ownership.
A frontend feature or application layer is added, renamed, moved, or removed.
Axios, TanStack Query, tenant context, session, or authorization policy changes.
A cross-context workflow is introduced or materially changed.
reviewChecklist: Every backend schema module is mapped to at least one frontend feature.
Every feature path in this manifest exists.
Feature dependencies follow the documented layer rules.
OpenAPI remains the request and response contract.
Significant architectural decisions receive an ADR.
The manifest and affected architecture diagrams are updated in the same pull request.

generationPolicy.frontend: This manifest may support documentation and structural validation, but implementation files must not be generated without a reviewed feature contract.
generationPolicy.backend: This manifest may inform backend bounded-context planning but must not generate database entities, repositories, or security rules. The backend schema, API contract, and backend ADRs remain authoritative.
generationPolicy.apiClient: Generate transport DTOs and clients only from the versioned OpenAPI contract.

recommendedAutomation: Validate this document against a JSON Schema in CI.
Check that declared feature paths exist.
Check that every backend schema module is represented exactly as intended.
Detect OpenAPI generated-client drift in CI.
